project.name: Standard Project Structure
project.description: Folders for raw, intermediate, and final inputs; scripts, functions, and notebooks; and outputs for models, tables, figures, and reports.

project_sensitive.name: Privacy Sensitive Project Structure
project_sensitive.description: The standard folders with inputs and outputs split into private and public. Marks the project sensitive.

presentation.name: Presentation Structure
presentation.description: One presentation.qmd rendered as slides, with data, scripts, functions, and outputs folders.

course.name: Course Structure
course.description: Folders for slides, modules, assignments, readings, and course documents. All but readings render into rendered/.

shiny.name: Shiny App Structure (R)
shiny.description: A Shiny app: app.R, R/ for functions, www/ for static files, and tests/.

README.md.content:
# {{project_name}}

A Shiny app. The interface and server are in app.R. Shiny loads the functions in R/ on its own.

Run it:

```
shiny::runApp()
```

plumber.name: Plumber API Structure (R)
plumber.description: A Plumber API: plumber.R for the endpoints, R/ for the logic, and tests/.

run.R.content:
# Run the API at http://127.0.0.1:8000. The docs are at /__docs__/
plumber::pr_run(plumber::pr("plumber.R"), port = 8000)

README.md.content:
# {{project_name}}

An API built with Plumber. The endpoints are in plumber.R, and the logic is in R/.

Run it:

```
Rscript run.R
```

shiny_python.name: Shiny App Structure (Python)
shiny_python.description: A Shiny for Python app: app.py, www/ for static files, and tests/.

README.md.content:
# {{project_name}}

A Shiny for Python app. The interface and server are in app.py.

Run it:

```
shiny run --reload app.py
```

fastapi.name: FastAPI Structure
fastapi.description: A FastAPI app: app/main.py for the endpoints and tests/ with a test client.

README.md.content:
# {{project_name}}

An API built with FastAPI. The endpoints are in app/main.py. The docs are at /docs once it runs.

Run it:

```
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

bare.name: Bare
bare.description: No folders, only the settings.yml every Framework project has.
